4: "Moshe explained to his father-in-law" - to connect to him to bring him near to the Torah. "Everything that Hashem did" - in giving the Torah to the Jewish people. "all the ordeal" - in Egypt. "That they experienced" - at the sea. "On the way" - this is the war against Amalek. "Hashem saved them" - the Omnipresent saved them from everything.
